content:
Looking for new iPhone and iPad games that suit you? The App Store has a huge selection of games with no ads and no in-app purchases.

Apple Arcade is a good family subscription plan, but it's not the only option. If you're a Netflix subscriber, you can already play plenty of excellent iPhone and iPad games.

Your Netflix subscription includes lots of iPhone and iPad games

Every Netflix subscription now comes with a whole bunch of mobile and TV games.

This includes the cheapest "Standard with ads" Netflix plan, at US$8.99 per month.

No matter which Netflix tier you've chosen, you'll get access to mobile and TV games, with no ads, no in-app purchases, and no extra fees.

As for TV games, Netflix offers an app designed for iPhone and iPad called Netflix Game Controller.

This app can turn your phone or tablet into a game controller, to be used with supported versions of the Netflix smart TV app. If you want to take your mobile gaming experience up a notch, pairing it with a proper dedicated iPhone controller is the best way to go.

Netflix also has an iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Playground, featuring mini-games designed for kids. There are also Netflix Puzzled: Logic Games (no subscription required) and Netflix Stories.

Beyond the games above, there's also a catalogue of more than 80 iPhone and iPad games. You can download any of them from the App Store, then log in with your Netflix email and password to start playing.
